purpose: Versioned Bing AI Performance manual CSV snapshots for article planning and refresh
update_procedure: Never overwrite existing date folders. Save new export files and manifest in a new YYYY-MM-DD folder; update latest_snapshot and append snapshots after verifying bytes and file SHA256. Old snapshots are immutable.
usage: Read the latest manifest and three original CSVs before refreshing article content; cross-check query data with current GSC/Bing data, article dates, primary documentation and Bing Pages attribution.
restrictions: Keep this metadata archival. Do not deploy as public site content or misstate market ranges as site citations.
